title: If We Were Villains
author: M.L. Rio
summary: Ten years after a conviction, Oliver Marks tells the detective who put him away what really happened. His story goes back to a tight group of Shakespeare students at an elite arts conservatory, and the night one of them died.
readIf: you like dark academia, a close-knit group of rivals and a murder that unfolds in the shadow of Shakespeare.
skipIf: you dislike heavy quotation of Shakespeare, or you want a fast-paced thriller rather than a slow, theatrical build.

pairings.reason: The classic of the type: an elite group of students, a death, and the aftermath told from inside.
Another story of gifted, competitive students in a closed world, with more fantasy and less murder.
A slow-burning mystery with a damaged narrator and a past that will not stay buried.
